# Matt McCarthy

> Portfolio and resume of Matt McCarthy, a full-stack software engineer based in Chicago, IL with 7+ years of experience building enterprise web applications in regulated healthcare and commercial environments.

Full-stack Software Engineer proficient in Angular, TypeScript, and Python/Django, with hands-on experience in cloud-native infrastructure (Docker, GCP, Kubernetes). Designed and delivered HIPAA and FDA 21 CFR Part 11-compliant systems supporting 10,000+ daily users across mission-critical healthcare platforms.
